throughline.zh: 台灣與新加坡公布製造業產出，德州晶圓投資仍在審查，馬來西亞更新資料中心工程與機房營運規則。
throughline.en: Taiwan and Singapore reported manufacturing output, a Texas fab proposal awaits review, and Malaysia updated data center construction and operating requirements.

title.zh: 台灣製造產出與晶圓廠投資
title.en: Taiwan manufacturing output and wafer fab investment

summary.zh: 台灣 10 月製造業生產年增 31.63%；台積電子公司德州申請表列約 216.55 億美元投資規劃，選址尚待決定。台電另提出大南科輸變電計畫，亞力公布電力設備在手訂單。
summary.en: Taiwan’s October manufacturing output rose 31.63% year over year, and a TSMC subsidiary listed US$21.66 billion in a Texas tax application ahead of a final site decision. Taipower outlined its Greater Tainan grid plan and Allis reported a power equipment backlog.

title.zh: 東南亞資料中心工程、供水和出口規則
title.en: Southeast Asia data center construction, utilities and export rules

summary.zh: 彭亨州稱甘孟資料中心首期動工，KJTS 另簽波德申機械工程分包，Sunway 則選定 HPE 私有雲。美方公開七家實體的列名文件，馬來西亞另說明機房供水審查，印尼談及跨境供電的國內法規。
summary.en: Pahang reported construction at Gambang, KJTS signed a Port Dickson mechanical subcontract and Sunway selected HPE private cloud. The U.S. previewed seven Entity List additions, while Malaysia addressed water checks and Indonesia discussed domestic power trade review.

title.zh: 新加坡製造產出與半導體工廠設備

summary.zh: 新加坡第三季製造業年增 8.5%，季調後季減 0.2%。美光移入首台 HBM 封裝設備、KLA 啟用宏茂橋新廠房，迅得另稱載板廠設備已運轉。
summary.en: Singapore’s manufacturing grew 8.5% year over year and fell 0.2% from Q2 after adjustment. Micron moved in its first HBM packaging tool, KLA opened a new building and Symtek reported operating equipment at a substrate plant.

title.zh: 半導體材料、晶圓測試與光電對位
title.en: Chip materials, wafer test and optical alignment

summary.zh: 漢測公布 10 月自結、登豐說明電源管理晶片導入。南寶更新膠材供貨，晶呈披露特氣出貨，立碁與東佑達的消息分別涉及模組送樣及光耦合對位開發。
summary.en: Hermes Testing released preliminary October results and GST described a power management IC design. Nan Pao and Jingcheng updated adhesive supply and specialty gas shipments, while Ligitek and TOYO were reported at module sampling and optical alignment development stages.

title.zh: 電子工廠投資與循環材料政策
title.en: Electronics factory investment and circular materials policy

summary.zh: 訊芯及 GIS-KY 更新越南投資和機電工程，台灣披露半導體腔體工具機取得德國訂單。東協公布關鍵礦物合作措施，台灣環境部另說明循環材料合作方向。
summary.en: ShunSin and GIS-KY updated Vietnam investment and electromechanical works, and Taiwan reported a German order for semiconductor chamber tools. ASEAN outlined critical minerals cooperation while Taiwan’s environment ministry described work on circular materials.
